title: Repository asset assessment
purpose: Assess one candidate repository asset using supplied evidence and return a bounded reuse recommendation for the Tool Repository intake process.

input_contract.name: evidence_references
input_contract.description: Approved evidence references with no secrets or customer content.

output_contract.name: reuse_recommendation
output_contract.description: Bounded recommendation with reasons and unresolved risks.

constraints: Use only the supplied evidence references.
Do not infer licence, provenance, or security facts that lack evidence.
Do not include secrets, private content, or hidden reasoning in the recorded outcome.

rendering.template: Assess the candidate repository asset using only the approved evidence references. State a bounded reuse recommendation, cite unresolved provenance, licence, safety, and maintenance risks, and do not claim that unverified behaviour has been tested.
